name: Stage 60: Viad to Berga vägskäl
description: Official Sörmlandsleden stage 60, Viad to Berga vägskäl.
utilities: Viad is the stage start/trail junction, but official Stage 60 says no parking there. Treat it as an awkward access point unless you are chaining from Stage 59 or have a pickup.

On-route facilities are concentrated around Stora Träsket: a small shelter, fireplace/grill, small jetty/rest context, reserve information, and nearby natural springs. No toilet was verified on the stage.
Myrudden is a second shelter/fireplace context just beyond the Stora Träsket shelter, likely matching the official mention of a scout-built shelter a little farther along.
Berga vägskäl/Bergavägen is the useful endpoint access node with SL 727 bus service toward Tumba/Skanssundet and limited/uncertain roadside parking context from Stage 61.

Brandalsund has nearby/off-route Viad-side reserve facilities: fireplaces, toilets, accessible parking, beach/rest context, and picnic/grill places. These are useful access/rest context within about 2 km, but not on-stage Stage 60 services.
Eldtomta and Klockargårdens Våffleri/Grödinge services are plausible off-route detour context near the eastern side, but not Stage 60 on-route services.
waterSources: Stage 60 has three official natural springs: near Stora Träsket after about 2 km, near Hallsveden/Myrudden after about 3.5 km, and near the Berga side after about 6-6.5 km. Use the coordinates rather than the inconsistent official distance wording.
All springs should be treated/filtered/boiled. Sörmlandsleden does not test or guarantee quantity/quality, and lake or wetland water around Stora Träsket is not a dependable refill plan.
Viad beach and Stora Träsket jetty/bathing context are unsampled natural waters in the sources checked; do not show EU bathing-water quality status for them.
No potable tap was verified on Stage 60, and no toilets were verified at the shelter, reserve, or endpoint.
notes: Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee water quality or availability; treat or filter natural sources and carry backup.
Shelters are generally free, shared, first-come, cannot be booked, and do not guarantee firewood or trash service.
In nature reserves, local camping and fire rules override allemansrätten; fires are often restricted to prepared fireplaces.

Use 7.5 km as the canonical official distance. Current OSM/Naturkartan geometry measures about 7.3 km, AllTrails appears short at about 6.9 km, OSM relation metadata rounds to 8 km, and the old OSM wiki 10 km value is stale.

Stage 60 runs from Viad along a stony Hallsfjärden shoreline section, then through Hallsveden/Stora Träsket forest and wetlands, past Bondberga/Kattkulla grave-field context, and out to Berga vägskäl/Bergavägen.

Official information listed no current Stage 60 fault reports during the 2026-04-28 research pass, but 2025 reviews mention worn boardwalks/footbridges, possible unclear/new-looking alignment near the Berga end when walking backward, and AllTrails being too short near the Viad start. Prefer current orange markings and OSM/Naturkartan relation 5279829 geometry.

A March 2026 local report described a roughly 200 x 300 m forestry/nature-care area in Stora Träsket, a damaged Sörmlandsleden sign, and planned path restoration over 1-3 years. Expect disturbed ground, changed sightlines, debris, or rougher navigation locally.

Stora Träsket reserve rules: fires only at designated places, dogs leashed, do not remove dead wood or damage vegetation, and camping/tenting is allowed for no more than two consecutive nights. Avoid shoreline trampling, floating mats, boggy wetland edges, spring-fed slopes, and off-trail wetland shortcuts.
Do not rely on firewood. Naturkartan says to bring your own charcoal/wood; Vindskyddskartan's older firewood note is stale enough that users should still carry fuel or plan no fire.
No Stage 60 toilet, shop, cafe, lodging, bin, or staffed facility was verified. Carry out trash and plan water/toilet needs before starting.

Viad start parking remains unresolved: official Stage 60 says no parking, while Länsstyrelsen/Naturkartan mention small reserve-access parking near Viads gård about 1 km from the reserve and the reserve plan describes only about four spaces. Treat it as limited/local reserve parking, not a reliable stage trailhead.

SL 727 is the practical access backbone, but the 2026 PDF has a summer validity gap and weekend service can be sparse. Use SL live planning and warn bikepackers that regular bikes/e-scooters generally cannot be taken on buses unless folded within SL limits.

facilities.name: Viad stage 60 start
facilities.description: Official Stage 60 start and Stage 59 endpoint by Hallsfjärden. No official parking at this stage start.

facilities.name: No official Viad parking
facilities.description: Sörmlandsleden explicitly lists no parking for Stage 60. Nearby reserve-access parking is separate, limited, and not a reliable stage trailhead.

facilities.name: Viad beach
facilities.description: Informal beach/swimming context immediately after the start, followed by a stony Hallsfjärden shoreline path. Not a registered sampled bathing site in the checked HaV/Botkyrka sources; water can deepen suddenly.

facilities.name: Brandalsund south fireplace
facilities.description: Nearby/off-route Brandalsund reserve fireplace with grill, table/benches and woodshed context. Södertälje also lists beach, grill and accessible picnic/rest context in Brandalsund. Useful access/rest option near the Viad side, not an on-stage Stage 60 facility.

facilities.name: Brandalsund south toilet
facilities.description: Nearby/off-route toilet context by Brandalsund south reserve area; Södertälje confirms toilets in the Brandalsund accessibility material. Do not count as an on-stage Stage 60 toilet.

facilities.name: Brandalsund south parking
facilities.description: Nearby/off-route reserve parking for Brandalsund south area, around 450 m from the fireplace. Separate from Stage 60, whose official page says no parking at Viad.

facilities.name: Hallsfjärden stony shore
facilities.description: First section follows a stony shoreline path before turning inland. Expect uneven footing and possible wet/slippery terrain.

facilities.name: Stora Träsket west spring
facilities.description: Official natural spring after about 2 km, west/near Stora Träsket. Treat/filter/boil and carry backup; Sörmlandsleden does not test or guarantee flow/quality.

facilities.name: Stora Träsket shelter
facilities.description: Official shelter by Stora Träsket, corroborated by OSM/Vindskyddskartan. Small shared shelter, roughly four sleeping places in shelter-map data; cannot be booked.

facilities.name: Stora Träsket fireplace
facilities.description: Designated fireplace/grill at the Stora Träsket shelter. Fires only when current rules allow and only at designated sites; bring your own wood/charcoal and do not remove dead wood in the reserve.

facilities.name: Stora Träsket jetty
facilities.description: Small jetty/brygga by the shelter and lake, mentioned in official and mapped sources. Treat bathing here as unsampled natural lake water.

facilities.name: Stora Träsket reserve rules
facilities.description: Nature reserve: fires only at designated places, dogs leashed, do not take dead wood/damage vegetation, and camping no more than two consecutive nights. Berry, flower and edible mushroom picking is allowed; do not remove wood-decay fungi.

facilities.name: Stora Träsket wetland sensitivity
facilities.description: Sensitive shallow forest lake, high-humidity forest and wetland/bog-edge environment with spring-fed slopes. Stay on marked paths/boardwalks, avoid trampling shoreline mats, and do not wash or disturb hydrology in lake/spring zones.

facilities.name: Stora Träsket forestry/signage warning
facilities.description: March 2026 local reporting described a roughly 200 x 300 m forestry/nature-care area, a damaged Sörmlandsleden sign, and planned path restoration over 1-3 years. Expect disturbed ground, debris, or changed sightlines.

facilities.name: Stora Träsket information board
facilities.description: Reserve information board near the Stora Träsket trail area.

facilities.name: Myrudden shelter
facilities.description: Second lean-to shelter/fireplace context, likely the scout-built shelter mentioned by the official stage text. Verify exact availability on site.

facilities.name: Hallsveden / Myrudden spring
facilities.description: Official natural spring after about 3.5 km near the Myrudden/Hallsveden area. Treat/filter/boil and carry backup; Sörmlandsleden does not test or guarantee flow/quality.

facilities.name: Boardwalk/alignment caveat
facilities.description: 2025 user reports mention renovation-needing boardwalks/footbridges around wet Stora Träsket sections, AllTrails being short near Viad, and possible unclear/new-looking alignment near Berga when walked backward. Follow current orange markings and report issues.

facilities.name: Viads gård reserve-access parking
facilities.description: Very small/limited reserve-access parking north of the stable at Viads gård, about 1 km from the reserve; the reserve plan describes only about four spaces. Not official Stage 60 trailhead parking.

facilities.name: Bondberga/Kattkulla grave field
facilities.description: Cultural-remains context: official text says the route passes one of the Stockholm area's largest grave fields and a Bronze Age cairn. Look, do not disturb.

facilities.name: Berga-side spring
facilities.description: Official natural spring listed after about 6 km in the facility strip and about 6.5 km in the text before Berga vägskäl. Treat/filter/boil and carry backup.

facilities.name: Stage 60 stale map-distance caveat
facilities.description: Current OSM/Naturkartan geometry is continuous at about 7.3 km and official distance is 7.5 km. Do not inherit the stale OSM wiki 10 km value or AllTrails' likely short 6.9 km line.

facilities.name: Berga vägskäl stage 60/61 junction
facilities.description: Stage 60 endpoint and Stage 61 start at Berga vägskäl/Bergavägen. OSM relation 5279829 connects cleanly to the Stage 61 start node within about 20 m; do not trim the final Bergavägen leg.

facilities.name: Bergavägen / Berga vägskäl bus 727
facilities.description: SL bus 727 access toward Tumba/Skanssundet, with stops roughly 10-15 m from the stage endpoint. The mapped stop is Bergavägen rather than literally Berga vägskäl; check SL live departures and stop names.

facilities.name: Berga limited roadside parking
facilities.description: Stage 61 says parking may be possible along a small road near the start. Treat as limited/uncertain roadside parking, not a formal lot.

facilities.name: Klockargårdens Våffleri detour
facilities.description: Possible cafe detour near Grödinge/Berga side; check opening hours and route before relying on it.
